# Resource: yet_settings_workspace

The company the API key belongs to, as its Settings have it.

~> **Note:** There is one company per key: creating this resource takes hold of it, and destroying it leaves the company as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "yet_settings_workspace" "acme" {
  name      = "Acme"
  open_join = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Shown at the top of every app and on the sign-in page.

### Optional

- `open_join` (Boolean) Whether anyone at the company's domains may join by themselves.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (List of String) The company's verified domains: who may sign in.
- `id` (String) The company's slug: its address, `<slug>.yet.com.br`.
- `mail_domains` (List of String) Its domains with mail here: where mailboxes can be made.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, with an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import):

```terraform
import {
  to = yet_settings_workspace.acme
  id = "acme"
}
```

With [`terraform import`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import):

```shell
# The company, by its slug.
terraform import yet_settings_workspace.acme acme
```
